title: FEM — ANSYS Demo: Hand Calculation vs Software

s1.description: Opening: predictions on paper, outcomes and the 3-hour plan

s2.description: Block 1: the Workbench workflow mapped onto the hand calculation, the ANSYS vocabulary and the unit conversions the inputs need

s3.description: Block 2: live demonstration of the text §2.3 plate in Steady-State Thermal — set-up, prediction, run, comparison with the hand results

s4.description: Block 3: live demonstration of the text §3.4 cantilever in Static Structural — linear versus quadratic elements, the mesh study and the convergence table

s5.description: Block 4: reading stress results in Mechanical, the reaction check, and four deliberately wrong versions of the cantilever and their symptoms

s6.description: Block 5: groups build and run the first mesh of their project model with a verification checklist; lecturers review each group's plan

s7.description: Block 6: summary of the hand-versus-software comparison, exit ticket and the bridge to the last session’s practical issues
